hints.title: Shortest Transformation Steps
hints.text: Find the shortest transformation distance by swapping mismatched characters one by one.

hints.title: First Mismatch Pivot
hints.text: Identify the first index i where current string does not match the target string.

hints.title: Targeted Candidate Swapping
hints.text: Swap index i with any later index j that holds the desired target character, breaking early if a mutual swap occurs.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of strings s1 and s2
complexity.notes: State-space search with pruning on the first mismatched position.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unpruned permutations explore all N! transitions resulting in exponential timeouts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited state set requires exponential memory in the worst case.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pivot on the first incorrect character and prioritize 2-cycle swaps.
